ValidationRule.description: If Users does not belong to profile IM_Proposal_Services , restrict them from editing the owner field of record type Proposal_Management_Request
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Proposal_Management_Request", ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), AND($Profile.Name <> "IM_Proposal_Services" ,$Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin" , $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have the permission to change the owner of this Record.
